'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Physician found managing the [[Pharmacies|Huaxu Apothecary]].

==Shop==

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:{{Icon/Quest|Pharmacy Store|20px}} I want some medicines.

:;(Open Shop)
::'''Jin:''' Welcome to Huaxu Academy. I'm Jin, the physician on call.

:;(Purchase)
::'''Jin:''' If you start feeling unwell again, you may come find me anytime.

:;(If not amount of [[Shell Credit]]s)
::''(I'm running low on Shell Credits. Maybe I'll come back another time.)''

:{{DIcon}} Chat

::'''Jin:''' They call me the physician on call, but in truth, most of my time is spent taking inventory of the Hold's medicine supplies.

::'''Jin:''' As with many other provisions, the Land of Xuanfang depends on outside delivery for its medicines. A shortage here is not easily corrected...

::'''Jin:''' For that reason, I have to guess ahead. What will the Wardens need, and how much? I send the list to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before it becomes an emergency.

:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
